raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "elyra-scala-editor-extension" %}
{% set version = "3.15.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/elyra-scala-editor-extension-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 73e600f44bb758cbe9291a9d2b4cff0059bc5fa8d35aa1318b8ce412060743fe

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 1

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - jupyter_packaging
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - elyra-server =={{ version }}
    - jupyter_packaging

test:
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/elyra-ai/elyra
  summary: Elyra provides AI Centric extensions to JupyterLab
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akchinSTC
    - lresende
